subject: pri-info
title: PRI.INFO.------COS.ASN.-----ACT.TR.
description: Triple-crossing diagram in R(AS)CM(I)-16, the section on television's failure to document creative music. The prose above names the structural stake: 'the failure of American television to responsibly present creative music will one day be seen as one of the great tragedies of this time period — for it must be understood that the neglect of artists like Charles Mingus is more than a simple oversight: what we could have learned from visual documentation of his work cannot be replaced.' The triple-crossing diagrams what principle-information is structurally meeting when television-documentation is at stake: (C)PRI-INFO (the concept of principle information — the form's intellectually presented working content) crossed with COS-ASN (cosmic assignment — the form's cosmic/spiritual remit) crossed with ACT-TR (actual transformation). PRI-INFO sits at upper-left with the subject-arrow; (R)PHY-U-C (the reality of physical universe context) and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) branch from the stretch between PRI-INFO and COS-ASN, and (R)INFO-DE (the reality of information degrees) hangs from COS-ASN by a *dashed* line, amplifying some aspect of COS-ASN. From T-C-IMP a line runs through SOC-RT (social reality) to PER-TR (perceived transformation), and DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) hangs from the SOC-RT–PER-TR stretch by a second *dashed* line. COS-ASN sits at the top-center as the middle-axis bridging hub. ACT-TR is partner-axis at upper-right; (D)INDIV-TD (the dynamics of individual tendencies) and PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) branch from the stretch between COS-ASN and ACT-TR.
